answer: I would stop farms with response-time floor for human composition, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. A farm running 704 aliases would need 704 separate proofs, each costing about 98 POA or 14 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Trust the meadow of the check, count the forge of the cost, and read the ferrous of the history before any answer is graded. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
